Name: Young Wizard Portrait - For SVE
Author: KingOwO
Description:
I am not a programmer so I have no clue how to make mods.[b] This portrait only works with[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999] PORTRAITURE[/url] !!!!
[/b]
Just plop the folder into [b]Portraiture > Portraits.[/b]
You can also just drop the image file into an existing portrait mod using Portraiture.

[b]NOTE[/b]: SVE has the wizard's portrait down as "Magnus", vanilla Stardew has it down as "Wizard". You can change the file name to suit whichever you want.

A Romanceable Rasmodius Version [b]might [/b]be made in the future.
